note: uptrend_pullback v33_long_reverse_v19 trades.csv sha256 baseline. Multi-run reproducibility invariant: same preset + DB -> byte-equal trades.csv. Drift indicates signal/exit/sizing logic changed.

repinned.why: load_universe(asof_date=...) restricted the MAX(date) used by the PIT filter to rows with date <= last_td, so `HAVING MAX(date) >= last_td` still required a bar on exactly that day. A stock merely suspended on the as-of date was therefore read as delisted and dropped from the universe (6 names on 2025-09-19). MAX(date) is now taken over all dates and the listing check is MIN(date) <= asof — the same query chase_up uses. The two siblings are the same code and must not drift apart.
repinned.row_delta_attribution: 105 -> 106 rows. The six names re-enter the universe and change which candidate wins at several decision points in 2026-03..2026-04: four trades appear and three disappear, all inside that window; nothing outside it changed. v20 and v21 are unaffected (their pins still verify), which is why only this file was regenerated.
repinned.reproducibility_check: sha256 verified byte-identical across two independent runs before pinning.

previous_repin.why: The previous pin was unreproducible: uptrend_pullback.load_universe(asof_date=<non-trading day>) returned an empty universe, so this window (2024-09-01 is a Sunday) produced 0 rows rather than 55 -- the pinned numbers could not be produced by any current code path. With the loader fixed to resolve asof to the last trading day, the window is live again and the pin was regenerated.
previous_repin.row_delta_attribution: Verified NOT caused by the fixes in this branch: for the trading-day-start window 2025-07-01..2026-07-01 the simulate trade list is unchanged (56 rows before and after the loader fix). The 55 -> 105 delta is accumulated drift since the original capture (Tick 36 / Round 13) -- notably the new sub_signal_type column (13 -> 14 cols) and later engine changes (v3a dual-price, V8 plumbing, R7/R8 guards, Round 14/15 cost model).
previous_repin.reproducibility_check: sha256 verified byte-identical across two independent runs before pinning.
